title: British Feet Grew Longer, Wider, And Under More Weight
hook: Changing shoe sizes reflect more than simple growth in length.
closing: Foot length, width, and body weight all matter when choosing shoes that fit.
question: Has your shoe size changed?

segments.say: Average British men's shoes reached size 10 today. Feet measure two sizes longer than in the 1970s.
Sixty-seven percent of women report wider feet in adulthood. The change is not limited to length.
Sixty-six percent of adults in England are overweight or obese. Body weight adds context to changing feet.
